Present : Lokesha. C.N,
 M.A., Ll.,B.

Xlvi Addl.C.J.M., Bengaluru.
 C.C.No.1614/2019
 10th day of July 2025
 Complainant: State by R.R. Nagar Police Station

(By A.P.P.)
 V/s  Accused:
 1. B.K. Puttaswamy  S/o. Late. Kullegowda  A/a 60 years  R/o. No.75, Gattigere New  Extenance, Bemal, 3rd stage  Rajarajeshwari Nagara  Bengaluru-98.
 (By Sri.L.S.Krishnegowda., Advocate)
 JUDGMENT
This is a charge sheet filed by R.R.Nagar Police station against the accused for the offence punishable Under Section 353 of IPC.
. The case of the prosecution in brief is that, the Cw.1 and Cw.4 are the police constables of R.R.Nagara police.

On 03.04.2018 the R.R.Nagar police have arrested a person by name Manjunath in respect of Cr.No.48/2018 for the offence punishable under section 420, 504 and 506 of IPC and kept said person in a cell of the police station and the Cw.6 who was SHO of said station as deputed the Cw.1 and Cw.4 to watch said person.
Then on 04.03.2018 at about 7.45 pm the accused suddenly enter the police station and went near the cell.
At that time the Cw.1 questioned the accused why he was there.
At that time the accused picked up quarrel and made altercation with the Cw.1.

When the Cw.1 and Cw.4 asked him to go outside of the station, the accused pushed the Cw.1 and Cw.4 and Gangadhar ,Pc-1331 vs B.K Puttaswamy on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13066585/
1 deter to discharge their official duty.

On the basis of the complaint given by the Cw,1 the Cw.7 registered a case in Cr.No.52/2018 and forwarded FIR to the Court, thereafter visited the place of incident and conducted Spot Mahazar in the presence of panch witnesses CW.2 and CW.3.

Thereafter the Cw.8 recorded statements of witnesses, having completed the investigation filed the charge sheet against the accused for the aforesaid offence.
3. After filing of the charge sheet, the presence of the accused was secured, thereafter the copies of the charge sheet papers furnished to the accused and after hearing both C.C.No.1614/2019 sides, the charges were framed, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried for the said offences.
4.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused the prosecution examined six witnesses as P.W.1 to P.W.6 and got marked document at Ex.P.1 to P3.
The statement of accused recorded as required u/s 313 of Cr.P.C.
The accused has denied the incriminating circumstances appeared against him in the evidence of prosecution and did not chose to lead the defense evidence.
5. I have heard the arguments from both sides and perused the entire record.
In the facts and circumstances of the case the following points arises for consideration.
POINTS Point No.1: Whether the prosecution proves an offence punishable Under Section 353 of IPC against the accused beyond all reasonable doubt?

6. Point No.1: under consideration is answered in the Negative for the following:
REASONS Point No.1:
7.
The PSI of R.R.Nagar police station filed the charge sheet against the accused for the offence punishable Under Section 353 of IPC.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused, the prosecution examined six witnesses as Pw.1 to Pw.6.
The Pw.1 is the complainant, Pw.2, Pw.4 and Pw.6 are eye witnesses, Pw.3 and Pw.5 are the investigation officers.
The Pw.1 in his evidence deposed that on 04.03.2018 from 01.00 pm to 8.00 pm he was deputed to watch a accused person who was arrested in respect of Cr.No.48/2018 who was in cell of the station.
At about 7.40 pm the accused suddenly enter the station and came near the cell.
When the Cw.1 questioned him he picked up altercation with him.
When he asked him to go outside he pushed the Cw.1.
At that time the Cw.4 and Cw.5 came near the Cw.1 then the accused pushed them also and abstracted for their duty.
Then he lodged a compliant as per Ex.P.1.

The Pw.2 who is police constable who is alleged to be deputed with Cw.1 in his evidence deposed that the accused suddenly enter the station and made an attempt to talk with the person who was in the cell of the station.
When the Cw.1 questioned him he picked up altercation then the Cw.1 and Cw.5 brought the accused from the police station.
The Pw.4 who is police constable in his evidence deposed in consonance with the evidence of Pw.1 and Pw.2.

The Pw.6 who is the police official and was SHO of the station at the time of alleged incident in his evidence deposed that on 04.03.2018 at Gangadhar ,Pc-1331 vs B.K Puttaswamy on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13066585/
2
about 7.45 pm when he was in duty he heard sound from inside the police station then the Cw.1 informed him about quarrel of the accused.
Then he brought the accused to the outside the police station.
As against the evidence deposed by the prosecution witnesses the defense that has been taken by the accused is complete denial the case of the prosecution.
The accused has taken specific defense that he did not abstract the official duty of Cw.1 and Cw.4.
The Ld. Counsel for the accused has cross-
examined the Pw.1, Pw.2 and Pw.4.
As per the prosecution case the Cw.1 and Cw.4 were deputed to watch a accused person who was in the cell inside the police station.
The Cw.5 was deputed as centri in front of police station and the Cw.6 who is ASI was SHO of station at that time and he was in siting in the entrance of the police station.
As per the prosecution case it is alleged that the accused suddenly enter the police station and went near the cell to talk with the person who is in the cell of the police station.
When the Cw.1 questioned him there was an altercation between them.

But the Pw.1, Pw.2, Pw.4 and Pw.6 during the course of cross-examination have clearly admitted that the Cw.6 who is SHO of station was sitting in the entrance of the police station and if any person wants to enter the police station, they have obtain permission by stating the purpose of their visit.
Further the Pw.1, Pw.2, Pw.4 and Pw.6 in their cross-examination have clearly admitted that the SHO used to enquiry the persons who are wants to enter the police station.

Therefore on the perusal of the said evidence it appears that it cannot be possible to accused enter suddenly to the police station without the permission of SHO who was C.C.No.1614/2019 sitting in the entrance and also when the Cw.5 was doing centri duty in front of the police station.

10. It is the case of the prosecution that there was a altercation between the accused and Cw.1 and Cw.4 and at that time the accused pushed the Cw.1 and Cw.4 and abstracted for discharging their duties.

In the present case at the time of incident the Cw.6 who is ASI of the station was discharging his duty as SHO of the police station and as per the evidence of Cw.6 he himself deputed the Cw.1,
Cw.4 and Cw.6 for specific duty.

Though the Cw.6 in his evidence deposed that when he was sitting in the entrance of the station, he heard the altercation from the inside of the police station, then the Cw.1 came near him and informed about the altercation.
The Pw.6 in his evidence did not depose anything about the abstraction of their duty by the accused by pushing the Cw.1, Cw.4 and Cw.5.
The Ld. Sr.APP treated the Pw.6 as hostile witness and cross-examined.
During the course of cross-examination the Ld. Sr. APP put a suggestion that the accused pushed the Cw.1, Cw.4 and Cw.5.
But the Pw.6 denied said suggestion and deposed that he did not gave any statement as per Ex.P.4 before investigation officer.

Therefore the Pw.6 who was the SHO of the police station at the time alleged incident as clearly denied the alleged act of the accused and denied the alleged statement which is said to have been given by him before the police as per Ex.P.4.
Therefore there are so many contradiction between the evidence of prosecution witnesses.
The Pw.4 during the course of cross-examination as clearly admitted that after obtaining permission from the SHO he leave the accused to the inside of the police station.

The Pw.6 did not Gangadhar ,Pc-1331 vs B.K Puttaswamy on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13066585/
3 deposed anything about the alleged quarrel.
Except the Pw.1, Pw.2, Pw.4 and Pw.6 who are the police official, there is no any independent eye witnesses to the alleged incident.
The Pw.6 who was the SHO of the police station at the time of alleged incident did not deposed any thing about the pushing of Cw.1 and Cw.4 by the accused.
As per the evidence Pw.6 there was altercation between the Cw.1 and accused inside the police station.
Then he went inside the police station and asked the accused to sit outside the police station.

Therefore on the perusal of the evidence prosecution witnesses it appears that, when the accused went inside the police station to visit said person who was in the cell of the police station there may be altercation between the accused Cw.1.
But to show that the accused has pushed the Cw.1 and Cw.4 there is no any evidence except the evidence of Cw.1 and Cw.4 to corroborate the version deposed by them.
The Pw.6 in his evidence did not deposed any thing about the assault or use criminal force to deter the Cw.1 and Cw.4 from discharge of their official duty.
12. The Pw.3 who is investigation officer deposed evidence in respect of registration of FIR, drawing of mahazer in the presence of Cw.2 and Cw.3.
The Pw.5 who is the investigation officer deposed evidence regarding having C.C.No.1614/2019 completed the investigation filed charge sheet against the accused.
As per the allegation of Cw.1 the accused asked him in loud voice to allow him to talk with the person who is in the cell of the police station.

Though in the Ex.P.1 it is mentioned that the accused has abstracted him from discharging of his official duty, but the Pw.6 did not depose any thing about the assault or use of criminal force by the accused to deter the Cw. 1 and Cw.4 from discharging their official duty.

13. As per section 353 of IPC, whoever, assaults or uses criminal force to any person being a public servant in the execution of his duty as such public servant or with intent to prevent or deter that person from discharging his duty is offence punishable under said section.
As per section 353 of IPC assaults or use of criminal force in necessary to prove the offence under said section.

As per section 349 of IPC a person is said to use force to another if he cause motion, change of motion to the other or if he causes substance into contact with any part of that other body or sense of feelings.

As per section 351 of IPC whoever makes any gestures or any preparation intending or knowing it to be likely that such gesture or preparation will cause any person present to apprehend that he who makes that gesture or preparation is about to use criminal force to that person, is said to commit an assault.

But in the present case as per the evidence of Pw.6 who is SHO of the police station at the time of alleged incident, there is no allegation assault or use of C.C.No.1614/2019 criminal for force by the accused to Cw.1 or Cw.4 to deter them from discharging their official duty.
Therefore as per the evidence of Pw.6, there is no any assault or use of criminal force by the accused to deter the Cw.1 and Cw.4 from discharging their official duty.

14. In the present case except the evidence of police officials, there is no any evidence of other independent eye witnesses regarding the alleged incident and the investigation officer did not record any statement of any other independent eye witnesses except the police officials.

As per the evidence of prosecution witnesses no person cannot enter the police station without the permission of the SHO who was sitting in the entrance of the police station and the Pw.4 deposed that himself leave the accused to inside of police station after obtaining permission of Cw.6 who was SHO of police station at that time.

As per the evidence of Pw.6 there is no any assault or use of criminal force by Gangadhar ,Pc-1331 vs B.K Puttaswamy on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13066585/
4 the accused to the Cw.1 and Cw.4 to deter them from discharging their official duty.
On the perusal of the evidence of prosecution witnesses and also defense of the accused persons reasonable doubt has been created in the case of the prosecution.
As per the evidence Pw.6 the accused did not assault or use any criminal force to deter the Cw.1 and Cw.4 from discharging their official duty.
Therefore a reasonable doubt has been created in the case of the prosecution and the benefit of doubt must go infavour of accused.

Hence, I answer point No.1 in the Negative and proceed to pass the following:
C.C.No.1614/2019 ORDER Exercising the power under section 248 (1) of Cr.P.C. the accused is acquitted for the offences punishable Under Section 353 of IPC.

The bail bond and surety bonds continued for another three months under section 437A of Cr.P.C.
(Dictated to the stenographer, transcribed and computerized by her corrected by me and then pronounced the judgment in the open court on 10th day of July 2025.)

(LOKESHA.C.N) 46th Addl.C.J.M.,Bengaluru.
ANNEXURE

PW1 : Gangadhar.
